description: An open-source remote desktop software, written in Rust.
notes: Administrator privileges are required because the official MSI installs the RustDesk system service.
RustDesk is fully installed and supports unattended access, UAC prompts, and the Windows login screen.

script: if (-not (is_admin)) { error 'Administrator privileges are required to install the RustDesk service.'; break }
$success = Invoke-ExternalCommand msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $args -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'A reboot is required to finish installing RustDesk.' }
if (-not $success) { error 'RustDesk MSI installation failed.'; break }
if (-not (is_admin)) { error 'Administrator privileges are required to uninstall the RustDesk service.'; break }
$success = Invoke-ExternalCommand msiexec.exe -ArgumentList @('/x', "`"$dir\setup.msi_`"", '/qn', '/norestart') -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'A reboot is required to finish uninstalling RustDesk.' }
if (-not $success) { error 'RustDesk MSI uninstallation failed.'; break }
